title: Enforcement Decree of the Korea Institute of Energy Technology Act
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA INSTITUTE OF ENERGY TECHNOLOGY ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea Institute of Energy Technology Act and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Registration of establishment)
① The Korea Institute of Energy Technology (hereinafter referred to as "KENTECH") shall register its establishment at the location of its principal office within three weeks after the date on which its articles of incorporation are authorized under Article 3 of the Korea Institute of Energy Technology Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").
② The matters to be registered under paragraph ① shall be:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Location of the principal office;
4. Names and addresses of officers;
5. Total value of assets.

Article 3 (Registration of relocation)
Where KENTECH relocates its principal office, it shall register the new location and date of relocation at either its former or new location within three weeks after the relocation.

Article 4 (Registration of changes)
Where any registered matter under the subparagraphs of Article 2 (2) changes (excluding relocation registered under Article 3), KENTECH shall register the change at the location of its principal office within three weeks after the change.

Article 5 (Documents accompanying applications for registration)
An application for registration under Articles 2 through 4 shall be accompanied by:
1. Registration of establishment under Article 2: The articles of incorporation of KENTECH;
2. Registration of relocation under Article 3: Documents evidencing relocation of the principal office;
3. Registration of changes under Article 4: Documents evidencing the changed matters.

Article 6 (Commencement of registration periods)
Where a matter to be registered under Articles 2 through 4 requires authorization or approval from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, the registration period shall commence on the date the authorization or approval document is received. <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 7 (Changes in location)
Where KENTECH intends to relocate and operate any part of its facilities to another location within the Republic of Korea other than the location under Article 2 (2) 3 (excluding changes to the location of its principal office), it shall obtain approval from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. The Minister shall consult with the Minister of Education before granting approval. <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 8 (Organization)
Matters concerning the organization of KENTECH shall be determined by its president following a resolution by the board of directors.

Article 9 (Organization and operation of the council)
① Members of the council of KENTECH under Article 9 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "council") shall be elected when the council is formed pursuant to paragraph (2) of the same Article: Provided, That the president may commission alumni and persons who may contribute to the development of KENTECH as council members.
② Council meetings shall be classified as regular or extraordinary meetings. Regular meetings shall be held at least once a year, and extraordinary meetings may be held from time to time, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation.
③ Election and commissioning of council members, council meetings and other matters necessary for composition and operation of the council not prescribed in paragraphs ① and ② shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 10 (Submission of budget requests for contributions)
① Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment intends to make contributions to KENTECH under Article 11 (1) of the Act, the Minister shall require KENTECH to submit, by April 30 each year, a request for the following year's contribution budget with:
1. The business plan for the following year under Article 14 (1);
2. Estimated income statement and statement of financial position for the following year;
3. Other documents necessary to clarify the budget. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
② Where the Minister recognizes the request under paragraph ① as reasonable, the Minister shall reflect it in the budget for the following year. <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 11 (Notification of contributions determined)
Where the contribution budget for the following year is finalized, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall notify KENTECH thereof. <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 12 (Payment, management and use of contributions)
① To receive contributions notified under Article 11, KENTECH shall submit an application for payment of contributions to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment with quarterly business plans and budget execution plans for the relevant year. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
② Upon receiving an application under paragraph ①, the Minister shall pay the contributions where the quarterly business plans and budget execution plans are deemed reasonable. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
③ KENTECH shall establish and manage a separate account for contributions paid under paragraph ②.
④ KENTECH shall use contributions paid under paragraph ② only for purposes specified in the quarterly business plans and budget execution plans.

Article 13 (Application mutatis mutandis of rules on payment of contributions)
Where the head of a central administrative agency other than the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, a local government or a public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions makes contributions to KENTECH under Article 11 of the Act, Articles 10 through 12 shall apply mutatis mutandis. In such cases, "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment" shall be construed as "head of a central administrative agency, local government or public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions". <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 14 (Business plans)
① A business plan for the following year submitted by KENTECH under Article 13 (1) of the Act shall include business objectives, policies and details of major projects, and its budget shall separately specify budgets necessary for facilities and equipment, research and operation.
② Where KENTECH intends to amend important matters of a business plan approved under Article 13 (1) of the Act, it shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment a business plan specifying proposed changes and reasons and obtain approval. Where matters concerning academic affairs are to be changed, the business plan shall also be submitted to the Minister of Education. <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 15 (Reports on settlement of accounts)
① Statements of the settlement of revenue and expenditure for the relevant business year submitted by KENTECH under Article 13 (2) of the Act shall be accompanied by:
1. An income statement and statement of financial position for the relevant business year;
2. A comparison of the business plan and implementation results for that year;
3. An opinion of the certified public accountant or accounting corporation conducting the examination;
4. An opinion of the auditor conducting the examination;
5. Other documents evidencing the settlement of accounts.
② KENTECH shall submit the statements under paragraph ① to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment by March 31 of the following year. <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 16 (Disposal of surpluses)
Where a surplus arises from the settlement of accounts for a business year, KENTECH shall apply it to make up losses carried forward and carry forward any remainder to the following year or transfer it to the development fund established under Article 17 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "development fund").

Article 17 (Donation and joint use of land, etc.)
A person intending to donate land, research facilities, research equipment or other property to KENTECH for joint use under Article 15 (1) of the Act shall conclude an agreement with KENTECH concerning procedures for donation and joint use: Provided, That procedures for soliciting and methods for using donated money or goods under Article 2, subparagraph 2 of the Act on Collection and Use of Donations and Promotion of Donation Culture shall be governed by the relevant statutes. <Amended on 2024.7.23>

Article 18 (Establishment and operation of development funds)
① "Income prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 17 (2) 3 of the Act means money transferred to the development fund under Article 16.
② "Projects prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 17 (3) 3 of the Act means:
1. Projects supporting students and researchers;
2. Projects concerning management and recognition of donors;
3. Projects concerning operation and management of the development fund.
③ KENTECH shall establish and maintain a separate account for the development fund and obtain approval from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment before reducing the principal of the fund. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
④ Where a contributor or donor under Article 17 (2) 1 of the Act designates the purpose of a contribution or donation for a specific project, KENTECH shall use the contribution or donation only for that purpose: Provided, That where changing the purpose is unavoidable, the contribution or donation may be used for another purpose with the prior consent of the contributor or donor.
⑤ Detailed matters necessary for operation and management of the development fund other than those prescribed in paragraphs ② through ④ shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 19 (Qualification requirements for faculty)
① Faculty members of KENTECH under Article 18 (1) of the Act shall be nationals of the Republic of Korea or foreigners who possess research leadership, teaching ability, insight and character befitting faculty members and meet the following requirements:
1. Professor: Having at least eight years of combined research performance, teaching or practical work experience after obtaining a doctoral degree;
2. Associate professor: Having at least four years of combined research performance, teaching or practical work experience after obtaining a doctoral degree;
3. Assistant professor: Having obtained a doctoral degree.
② Years of research, teaching and practical work experience under paragraph ① 1 and 2 shall be calculated as follows:
1. Research experience: Years spent conducting research in the intended field of appointment or a closely related field at a four-year university or higher educational institution or a research institution recognized by the president;
2. Teaching experience: Years spent teaching in the intended field of appointment or a closely related field at a four-year university or higher educational institution;
3. Practical work experience: Years spent performing duties in the intended field of appointment or a closely related field at a central administrative agency, local government, public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions or an industrial enterprise or institution recognized by the president.
③ Matters concerning appointment of invited professors and lecturers under Article 18 (1) of the Act shall be prescribed by school regulations.

Article 20 (Special appointment)
① Notwithstanding Article 19 (1), the president may specially appoint or promote as a faculty member a person recognized as having outstanding research achievements following a resolution by the board of directors.
② Notwithstanding Article 19 (1), where necessary to fill faculty positions in departments in which it is difficult to recruit holders of doctoral degrees or in which practical work experience is required, the president may specially appoint a graduate of a four-year university or a person recognized by statutes as having equivalent or higher academic qualifications who meets the following requirements, following a resolution by the board of directors:
1. Professor: Having at least 12 years of combined research, teaching or practical work experience;
2. Associate professor: Having at least eight years of combined research, teaching or practical work experience;
3. Assistant professor: Having at least five years of combined research, teaching or practical work experience.

Article 21 (Classification of faculty)
① Faculty members under Article 18 (1) of the Act shall be classified as full-time or non-full-time faculty.
② A retirement age system shall apply to full-time faculty, and detailed matters shall be prescribed by school regulations following a resolution by the board of directors.

Article 22 (Professor emeritus)
The president may confer the title of professor emeritus, as prescribed by school regulations, on a person of outstanding integrity and reputation with exceptional research achievements who has contributed or can contribute to the development of KENTECH.

Article 23 (Establishment of plans to promote gender equality)
① A plan necessary for active measures concerning faculty appointments to promote gender equality under Article 19 (2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "gender equality action plan") shall include:
1. Target ratios of incumbent faculty by gender and academic discipline;
2. Target ratios of newly appointed faculty by gender and academic discipline;
3. Other matters concerning faculty appointments to promote gender equality.
② Academic disciplines of faculty for purposes of establishing gender equality action plans shall be classified in accordance with the classifications in attached Table 1 of the Regulations on Establishment and Operation of Universities.
③ The president shall formulate a gender equality action plan and submit it to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment by December 31 of the year preceding its commencement. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
④ The president shall submit the performance results of the gender equality action plan to the Minister by March 31 each year. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
⑤ Upon receiving performance results under paragraph ④, the Minister may request the president to submit materials concerning measures necessary to achieve the plan's objectives. The president shall cooperate unless there is a special reason not to do so. <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 24 (Evaluation of faculty qualifications and performance)
① The president shall examine faculty qualifications and evaluate faculty members' performance.
② Criteria for examinations and evaluations under paragraph ① shall be prescribed by school regulations.

Article 25 (Student admission quotas)
① The president shall adjust and determine student admission quotas for KENTECH under Article 23 (1) of the Act, considering projected demand for science and technology personnel and KENTECH's capacity.
② The president shall establish a plan for student admission quotas, obtain approval from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment before entrance examinations, and report to the Minister of Education. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
③ Before granting approval under paragraph ②, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall consult with the Minister of Education. <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 26 (Eligibility for admission)
① Persons eligible for admission to undergraduate degree programs at KENTECH under Article 23 (1) of the Act shall be:
1. Graduates of high schools or persons recognized by the Minister of Education as having equivalent or higher academic qualifications;
2. Persons who completed educational courses abroad equivalent to high schools under Article 2, subparagraph 3 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act;
3. Persons expected to complete the second year of high school who possess exceptional capabilities in science and technology or meet other requirements prescribed by school regulations.
② Persons eligible for admission to master's or professional master's programs at KENTECH under Article 23 (1) of the Act shall be:
1. Graduates of four-year universities who have received, or are expected to receive, a bachelor's or higher degree under Article 35 (1) of the Higher Education Act;
2. Graduates or prospective graduates of foreign four-year universities, or persons who completed at least 16 years of formal education abroad;
3. Persons recognized by the Minister of Education as having academic qualifications equivalent to or higher than those under subparagraph 1;
4. Students enrolled in four-year universities who meet requirements determined by the president.
③ Persons eligible for admission to doctoral programs at KENTECH under Article 23 (1) of the Act shall be:
1. Persons who have received, or are expected to receive, a master's or higher degree under Article 35 (2) of the Higher Education Act;
2. Persons who completed a master's course at a foreign university or at least 18 years of formal education abroad;
3. Students in master's or professional master's programs at KENTECH or other graduate schools of science and engineering who meet requirements determined by the president.

Article 27 (Foreign students)
With respect to foreign applicants, the president may recognize eligibility for admission only for persons satisfying Article 26 after examining the types of schools they graduated from, periods of study and related matters.

Article 28 (Methods of admission)
① Admission screening under Article 23 (1) of the Act shall be conducted through document review, written examinations and interviews: Provided, That the president may omit part of these procedures or add other examinations where deemed necessary.
② Detailed matters concerning admission methods, including timing and the allocation of marks by subject, shall be determined by the president.
③ The president shall establish and publish a plan for implementing admission screening under paragraphs ① and ② (hereinafter referred to as an "admission screening plan") at least ten months before the commencement of the school year preceding each admission year.
④ When establishing or amending an admission screening plan under paragraph ③, the president shall obtain approval from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and report it to the Minister of Education. <Amended on 2025.10.1>
⑤ Before granting approval under paragraph ④, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall consult with the Minister of Education. <Amended on 2025.10.1>

Article 29 (Measures for fostering creative energy specialists)
Measures for fostering creative energy specialists established and implemented by the president under Article 23 (2) of the Act shall include:
1. Training research personnel in promising future fields relating to energy industry technologies;
2. Fostering entrepreneurs and interdisciplinary talent related to the energy industry;
3. Other matters deemed necessary by the president to foster creative energy specialists.

Article 30 (Reduction or exemption of tuition and payment of scholarships)
KENTECH may reduce or exempt tuition and other school expenses or provide scholarships to students in each degree program.

Article 31 (Periods of study by program)
Periods of study for each program under Article 24 (2) of the Act shall be as follows, and the minimum period of study required and the maximum period of enrollment permitted for each degree program shall be determined by the president:
1. Undergraduate program: Four years;
2. Master's and professional master's programs: At least two years;
3. Doctoral program: At least two years.

Article 32 (Semesters and school days)
① In principle, an academic year shall consist of two semesters under Article 24 (2) of the Act: Provided, That the president may establish three or more semesters in an academic year where deemed necessary.
② Each academic year shall have at least 32 weeks of instruction under Article 24 (2) of the Act.

Article 33 (Course credits)
Credits shall be the units for completion of courses at KENTECH under Article 24 (2) of the Act, and the president shall determine methods of completion, including the credits required for each degree program.

Article 34 (Joint operation of curricula with domestic and foreign universities and research institutions)
Under Article 24 (4) of the Act, the president may jointly operate undergraduate, master's, professional master's or doctoral degree programs with domestic or foreign universities and research institutions related to knowledge-based industries and advanced science.

Article 35 (Criteria for imposing administrative fines)
Criteria for imposing administrative fines under Article 31 (1) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table.

Article 36 (School regulations)
Detailed matters necessary for degree programs, management of faculty and students, operation of KENTECH, etc. other than those prescribed by this Decree shall be prescribed by school regulations.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 31656, 2021.4.30>

Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Decree shall enter into force on May 2, 2021.

Article 2 (Applicability and special provisions concerning admission screening plans)
① Article 28 (3) shall apply beginning with admission screening plans for the 2024 academic year.
② Notwithstanding Article 28 (3), admission screening plans for the 2022 and 2023 academic years shall be established and published by May 31, 2021.

Article 3 (Special provisions concerning requirements for establishment of facilities, equipment and faculty)
KENTECH may be established by meeting the following establishment requirements by the scheduled opening date under the main sentence of Article 3 of the Addenda to the Korea Institute of Energy Technology Act (Act No. 17982):
1. Securing school buildings meeting all of the following requirements:
(a) Educational and research facilities shall be secured through ownership by KENTECH or by leasing educational and research facilities from the State, a local government, a public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions, a government-funded research institute under Article 2 of the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Research Institutes, etc., or a government-funded science and technology research institute under Article 2 of the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Science and Technology Research Institutes, etc. Leased educational and research facilities shall be deemed school buildings;
(b) The total floor area of school buildings shall be at least the standard area per student (20 square meters) multiplied by the student admission quota;
2. Securing faculty (meaning professors, associate professors and assistant professors under Article 18 (1) of the Act; hereinafter the same shall apply) numbering at least the admission quota (calculated as the undergraduate admission quota plus 1.5 times the combined doctoral, professional master's and master's admission quotas) divided by the number of students per faculty member (20).

ADDENDA (ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON COLLECTION AND USE OF DONATIONS AND PROMOTION OF DONATION CULTURE) <Presidential Decree No. 34728, 2024.7.23>

Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 31, 2024.
Article 2 (Amendments to other statutes) ① through ⑩ Omitted.
⑪ Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Korea Institute of Energy Technology Act shall be amended as follows:
In the proviso to Article 17, "Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Act on Collection and Use of Donations" shall be replaced with "Article 2, subparagraph 2 of the Act on Collection and Use of Donations and Promotion of Donation Culture".
⑫ and ⑬ Omitted.
Article 3 Omitted.

ADDENDA (PRESIDENTIAL DECREE PARTIALLY AMENDING 78 STATUTES TO IMPROVE PROVISIONS CONCERNING REGISTRATION OF CORPORATIONS) <Presidential Decree No. 35228, 2025.1.21>

This Decree shall enter into force on January 31, 2025.

ADDENDA (ORGANIZATION OF THE MINISTRY OF TRADE AND INDUSTRY AND ITS AFFILIATED AGENCIES) <Presidential Decree No. 35803, 2025.10.1>

Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among Presidential Decrees amended under Article 6 of these Addenda, the portions amending Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but not yet effective shall each enter into force on the enforcement date of the relevant Presidential Decree.
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendments to other statutes) ① through <93> Omitted.
<94> Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Korea Institute of Energy Technology Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 6; the former and latter parts of Article 7; the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 10 (1) and Article 10 (2); Article 11; Article 12 (1) and (2); the former and latter parts of Article 13; the former part of Article 14 (2); Article 15 (2); Article 18 (3); Article 23 (3) and (4), the former part of Article 23 (5); Article 25 (2) and (3); and Article 28 (4) and (5), each occurrence of "Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy" shall be replaced with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".
<95> through <101> Omitted.
